title: fix(plasma): Plasma Profile takes a start pick and an exit pick
body:
## What changed

- Plasma Profile takes a start pick and an exit pick. Its pick capability is `Ring` (`KindInfo::pick()`).
- The picks are the operation-level `picks` of #3339 / PR #3871. This PR adds no field, no command and no MCP tool.
- Start pick: the lead-in of the nearest closed contour lands on the projection of the pick on the profile. The pierce is at the start of that lead-in, in the scrap.
- Exit pick: the torch cuts the full contour. Then it cuts on to the projection of the exit pick. The lead-out leaves there and the torch goes off at its end.
- Small-hole rule: the pierce stays at the centre and there is no lead-out. A start pick sets where the straight lead-in meets the hole. An exit pick sets where the torch goes off. It must be at or past the overburn.
- Each contour without a pick keeps its automatic seam.
- A pick that a law cannot hold is refused by name. It is never moved. The text names the role and the point:
  - a pick farther than 1.5 kerf widths from each closed profile;
  - a pick when the operation has open runs only;
  - a lead-in or a lead-out with no room beside the part at the pick (the pierce or the torch off would be on the part);
  - a small-hole lead-in from the centre that would cross the part;
  - a small-hole exit pick inside the overburn;
  - an exit pick with control compensation (G41/G42), at the command door and in the generator.
- The kerf law and the cover law still judge the complete path.
- New generator door: `camcraft_motion::plasma::plasma_profile_picked`. `plasma_profile` calls it with no pick.

## Cause

`KindInfo::pick()` answered `NotTaken(PICK_OWED)` for Plasma Profile. The command refused each pick on the kind. The generator always chose the seam (`longest_mid`, or the point nearest the centre for a small hole).

## Where the issue is silent (smallest change taken)

- Which contour takes a pick: the closed contour whose profile is nearest. The reach is 1.5 kerf widths (the 2D contour uses 1.5 tool diameters).
- How the cut gets to the exit: a run past the start in the cut direction. The stretch between the start and the exit is cut two times. A note on the path gives its length.
- "After the overburn": only the small-hole rule has an overburn. There the exit must be at or past it. A contour with leads has no overburn, so the exit pick alone sets the run.
- An exit pick with G41/G42 is refused by name. The programmed contour ends at its start, and a longer one needs a new proof of the compensation span. Mutation M2 showed that the generator emits a path without that refusal.
- Waterjet: `WaterjetProfile` is on `main` now, with its own planner and tabs. This PR does not change it. A pick on it is still refused by name. The slice is #3983.
- UI: this PR changes no UI file. The operation page reads `KindInfo::pick()`.

The decision record is `docs/decisions/3334-plasma-start-exit.md`.

## Tests

Final head: `845228ac0`, on `upstream/main` `10ea81a2a`.

Pins (new):

- `camcraft-app`, `start_exit_shared` suite, submodule `start_exit_shared/plasma.rs` (7 tests):
  - `the_pierce_is_at_the_start_pick_and_the_torch_goes_off_at_the_exit_pick` (golden CL `plasma_start_exit_picks.cl`)
  - `a_pick_whose_pierce_falls_on_the_part_is_refused_by_name`
  - `a_pick_that_is_far_from_each_profile_is_refused_by_name`
  - `a_small_hole_keeps_its_rule_under_the_picks`
  - `an_exit_pick_under_control_compensation_is_refused_at_the_door`
  - `undo_and_redo_restore_the_picks_and_the_path`
  - `the_plasma_profile_takes_a_start_pick_and_an_exit_pick`
- `camcraft-app`, `mcp_plasma`: `plasma_mcp_edit_operation_sets_the_start_and_exit_picks` (MCP `edit_operation` sets the picks, `generate` holds them, undo clears them, a far pick is refused by name).
- `camcraft-app`, `start_exit_shared`: `every_kind_has_one_pick_capability_and_only_the_taken_ones_take_a_pick` (extended: Plasma Profile is `Ring`).
- `camcraft-motion` lib, `plasma::picks_tests` (9 tests), with `no_pick_is_the_automatic_path_move_for_move`.

Red before the fix: I put the six source files of `upstream/main` back and ran the app pins. All 7 plasma pick tests failed, the MCP pin failed and the capability test failed (`left: NotTaken("the planner chooses the entry and the exit of this kind until its slice of #1448 ships")`). With the fix, all pass.

Mutation results (one guard off for each run, then restored; each run was red, and green after the restore):

| # | Guard off | Red test |
|---|---|---|
| M1 | reach (`d > reach`) | `plasma::picks_tests::a_pick_that_no_law_can_hold_is_refused_by_name` |
| M2 | exit pick with control compensation (generator) | `plasma::picks_tests::control_compensation_holds_the_start_pick_and_refuses_the_exit_pick` |
| M3 | open runs take no pick | `plasma::picks_tests::a_pick_that_no_law_can_hold_is_refused_by_name` |
| M4 | `PathPicks::refusal` (two picks of a role, a pick that is not a number) | `plasma::picks_tests::a_pick_that_no_law_can_hold_is_refused_by_name` |
| M5 | small-hole lead-in across the part | `plasma::picks_tests::a_small_hole_lead_in_that_would_cross_the_part_is_refused_by_name` (the kerf law still refused the path, without the name of the pick) |
| M6 | small-hole exit inside the overburn | `plasma::picks_tests::a_small_hole_keeps_its_rule_and_its_overburn` |
| M7 | the name of the pick in the lead refusal | `a_pick_whose_pierce_falls_on_the_part_is_refused_by_name` |
| M8 | command door (`PlasmaOp::pick_refusal` in `sane.rs`) | `an_exit_pick_under_control_compensation_is_refused_at_the_door` |

Gates:

- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: 762 steps, 0 failed, 0 stalled. This run was on head `0d0945471` (base `97a676e5c`). It includes `example_catalog`, `example_catalog_adaptive`, `example_catalog_edge_work`, `golden_cl`, the `camcraft-motion` lib and the `camcraft-ui` lib.
- Then `upstream/main` moved by 8 commits (PR #3957, the wire exit pick, changes `pick_kinds.rs` and `start_exit_shared.rs`). I rebased the branch (it was not pushed yet). There was no conflict. I moved the pin file into the `start_exit_shared` suite. The source files did not change after the full run.
- On the rebased tree I ran again: `motion suites: lib`, `ui suites: lib`, and the app suites `start_exit_shared`, `mcp_plasma`, `golden_cl`, `example_catalog`, `example_catalog_adaptive`, `example_catalog_edge_work`, `plasma_profile`, `plasma_gate`, `plasma_post`, `plasma_machine`, `plasma_cut_data`, `post_serves_plasma`, `coarse_probe_plasma`, `waterjet_profile`, `wire_contour`, `contour_start_point`, `cut_recipe`, `pick`, `project_roundtrip`. All passed.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-motion -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean on the final head.
- `cargo xtask gate light`: not completed. Step `[01] light build (release --no-run)` did not get past three dependency crates (`boa_engine`, `flecs_ecs`, `reqwest`) in 50 minutes on the shared machine. I stopped it. No light step ran, so there is no light result for this head. The light twins are `motion light: lib`, three `adaptive_troch_*` suites and `app light: pocket_pass_start`. The review must run this lane.

## Goldens moved

- Added: `crates/app/tests/golden/plasma_start_exit_picks.cl` (new file, the picked path of the pin).
- Changed: none. `git diff --stat upstream/main -- "*.nc" "*.cl" examples/catalog` shows only the new file. `golden_cl` (with `plasma_plate_with_holes.cl`) and the three `example_catalog*` suites pass without a regeneration.

## Not exercised

- The full heavy lanes. `cargo xtask gate heavy --base upstream/main --dry-run` reaches 107 release steps. AGENTS.md "Heavy lanes at review" (#3556) gives a `P2` PR no heavy step, and the full lanes run at the cut. No heavy test in the reach is a plasma test.
- The posted G-code of a picked path on a machine. `plasma_post` and `post_serves_plasma` pass, but no new posted golden has a pick. The CL golden pins the path.
- The GUI. No UI file changed, so there is no screenshot. I did not start the application.
- The waterjet kind (#3983).
- A pick on a part with many nested contours at almost the same distance from the pick.

## Overlaps

- #3980, #3978, #3970, #3981: they touch `KindInfo::pick()` in `crates/app/src/operation/pick_kinds.rs` and the kind list in `crates/app/tests/start_exit_shared.rs`. Each changes the arm of its own kind. Whichever merges second refreshes.
- #3981 also adds a submodule to the `start_exit_shared` suite (`mod turning;`). This PR adds `mod plasma;` at the same place.
- #3832, #3674, #3103: they touch `crates/app/src/operation/types/sane.rs`, a different arm of the same `match`. Whichever merges second refreshes.

Changelog: Plasma Profile takes a start point and an exit point: the pierce is at the lead-in that lands on the start pick, the lead-out and the torch off are at the exit pick, and a pick that a plasma law cannot hold is refused by name.

Effort: high

Fixes #3334
